339-677-8095-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3174-3752-8193.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You have a way to kill Phage.
3174-3752-8193.description:
Donate control of Avacyn to an opponent using Switcheroo.
Kill Phage by any method.
At the beginning of the next end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Phage from your graveyard to the battlefield under the opponent's control.
When Phage enters, its first ability triggers, causing the opponent to lose the game.

5078-5243-7060-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-5147-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-5147-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-5147-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-4742.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-4742.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

215-3151-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
215-3151-6633.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Elvish Archdruid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Elvish Archdruid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2438-3192-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
2438-3192-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

283-3197-5189-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, targeting Herd Baloth
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Ghave's ability, targeting Berta.
Resolve the first Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the second Ghave ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3110-4499-7494.easyPrerequisites: "Seething Song" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
3110-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying {R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

413-4276-5088-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
413-4276-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
413-4276-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance and tapping it, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Turnabout with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
When Emeritus of Abundance enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Turnabout.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation and tapping it, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7415.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Old-Growth Educator.
When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2308-4050-4871-7399.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4871-7399.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Bogwater Lumaret trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-6972-7322.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Big Mother Mouser enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

2743-6231-7317.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-6231-7317.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Here Comes a New Hero! by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Here Comes a New Hero! at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Here Comes a New Hero! spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary and causing a player to draw nine cards.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

1818-2034-3490-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-2034-3490-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1308-2457-4289-6965.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

3334-4968-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Lae'zel.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3334-4968-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

431-1270-2557-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1545-2919-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1545-2919-3197.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Permanent with "You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life"

2656-2749--84.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Resolve all Wall of Blood abilities.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each opponent's life total to become 0.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

1887-2060-2092-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1887-2060-2092-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

465-803-1115-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-803-1115-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2557-4214-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2557-4214-5189-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1244-3859-4231-5542.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with mana value 2 or less.
1244-3859-4231-5542.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and another creature with mana value 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Cast the other creature by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Repeat.

539-618-3932.notablePrerequisites: You control a land except Kiki-Jiki that can tap to produce mana this turn.
539-618-3932.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hope Tender with haste.
Activte a mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate the Hope Tender token's second ability by paying {1}, exerting and tapping it, untapping Kiki-Jiki and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.

914-2043-3263.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2043-3263.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and Treasure tokens, you may use Urza to make infinite copies of any permanents you control.

598-2452-2523-5204.notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least three loyalty counters on it.
598-2452-2523-5204.description:
Activate Liliana's third ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Shapesharer by paying {2}{U}, causing it to become a copy of Ratadrabik until your next turn.
Put the original Ratadrabik into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each other copy of Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ratadrabik that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Cast Ratadrabik from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 3.

2837-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2837-4050-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat.

610-3718.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
610-3718.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting any indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Archmage Emeritus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Chain of Acid, failing to destroy the indestructible permanent and choosing to copy Chain of Acid, targeting the indestructible permanent with the copy.
Repeat from step 2.

1494-2744-3557.notablePrerequisites:
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Brago cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You control at least five creatures.
1494-2744-3557.description:
Deal combat damage with Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking at least five creatures.
Cathars' Crusade triggers for each creature that enters the battlefield.
Resolve the first Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

444-1786.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
Your deck size is greater than your opponents' combined life totals.
444-1786.description:
Draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
